trimps.howToPlay: Start with a small group of Trimps and gather resources. Build structures, assign workers, and expand your territory. Progress through zones, unlock new mechanics, and upgrade your Trimps. The game continues while you are offline, so returning after a break means a big payoff. Manage resources carefully to keep progressing.
trimps.modes: Single-player idle strategy with persistent offline progression.
tips: Balance resource gathering with building.
Upgrade your Trimps regularly.
Do not neglect defense — enemies get stronger.
Use the wiki for help with complex systems.
trimps.controls: Mouse and keyboard — click buttons and menus to manage resources and buildings.
features: Deep idle strategy gameplay.
Persistent offline progression.
Many systems and mechanics to master.
Free to play in the browser.

faq.q: What is Trimps?
faq.a: Trimps is a browser-based idle strategy game about managing resources and expanding your civilization.

faq.q: Does it progress offline?
faq.a: Yes, the game continues while you are away.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, Trimps is free to play.

swarmsim.title: Swarm Simulator
swarmsim.intro: Swarm Simulator is an idle game about growing and upgrading a swarm of insects. Starting with a single larva, you expand your hive, unlock new units, and push toward enormous numbers. It is a classic incremental experience with a satisfying progression curve.
swarmsim.howToPlay: Begin by producing larva and gathering meat. Spend resources to buy and upgrade units. Expand your territory and unlock new mechanics as you progress. The game continues offline, so you accumulate resources while away. Optimize your production and push toward new milestones.
swarmsim.modes: Single-player idle progression with offline gains.
tips: Focus on efficient upgrades early.
Balance production and expansion.
Check in regularly for offline rewards.
Do not spread resources too thin.
swarmsim.controls: Mouse — click buttons and menus to manage your swarm.
features: Classic idle gameplay.
Offline progression.
Deep upgrade systems.
Free to play in the browser.

faq.q: What is Swarm Simulator?
faq.a: Swarm Simulator is a browser-based idle game where you grow and upgrade a swarm of insects.

faq.q: Does it progress offline?
faq.a: Yes, the game continues while you are away.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, Swarm Simulator is free to play.

candybox2.title: Candy Box 2
candybox2.intro: Candy Box 2 is a minimalist idle adventure game full of secrets, puzzles, and hidden depth. What starts as a simple candy-producing game slowly reveals quests, combat, and an entire world to explore. It is a unique, charming experience that rewards curiosity.
candybox2.howToPlay: Start by producing candy, then explore the interface to discover new actions and systems. As you progress, you unlock quests, equipment, and combat. The game is full of hidden mechanics and secrets — try everything. Explore the world, fight enemies, and uncover the story. There is no wrong way to play.
candybox2.modes: Single-player idle adventure with exploration and secrets.
tips: Try every button and option.
Do not rush — discovery is the point.
Keep notes of things you want to try.
Search for secrets in unexpected places.
candybox2.controls: Mouse and keyboard — click buttons and interact with the interface.
features: Minimalist idle adventure game.
Full of secrets and hidden mechanics.
Unique and charming experience.

faq.q: Is it free?

little-alchemy.title: Little Alchemy
little-alchemy.intro: Little Alchemy is the original element-combining puzzle sandbox. Start with four basic elements and combine them to discover hundreds of new items, from plants and animals to mythical creatures and technology. It is a relaxing, curiosity-driven game that is easy to pick up and hard to put down.
little-alchemy.howToPlay: Drag elements onto the workspace and combine them. Valid combinations produce new elements. Start with water, fire, earth, and air, then work outward. The goal is to discover all the elements. There is no timer or failure — just experiment and have fun.
little-alchemy.modes: Single-player puzzle sandbox with a full element collection to complete.
tips: Keep basic elements accessible.
Think logically about combinations.
Use hints if you get stuck.
Explore related categories together.
little-alchemy.controls: Mouse or touch — drag and drop elements to combine them.
features: Hundreds of elements to discover.
Relaxing, no-pressure puzzle gameplay.
Classic element-combining sandbox.
Free to play in the browser.

faq.q: What is Little Alchemy?
faq.a: Little Alchemy is a puzzle sandbox where you combine basic elements to discover hundreds of new ones.

faq.q: How many elements are there?
faq.a: There are hundreds of elements to discover.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, Little Alchemy is free to play.

mapcrunch.title: MapCrunch
mapcrunch.intro: MapCrunch is a simple but addictive exploration tool that teleports you to a random street view location anywhere in the world. Look around, figure out where you are, and explore the planet from your browser. It is a relaxing way to travel without leaving your seat.
mapcrunch.howToPlay: Click the button to be dropped in a random location. Look around using the street view controls. Try to guess where you are, or just enjoy the scenery. You can also choose specific countries or regions to explore. There is no goal — it is all about discovery.
tips: Look for signs and language clues to identify locations.
Use the sun and vegetation to guess the region.
Try the 'guess the location' challenge for a game.
Explore specific countries for a more focused experience.
mapcrunch.controls: Mouse — click and drag to look around, use the map and menus to navigate.
features: Random street view exploration.
Real-world locations around the globe.
Simple, relaxing experience.
Free to use in the browser.

faq.q: What is MapCrunch?
faq.a: MapCrunch is a tool that drops you in a random street view location for exploration or location guessing.

faq.q: Can I choose a country?
faq.a: Yes, you can select specific regions or countries to explore.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, MapCrunch is free to use.

freerice.title: FreeRice
freerice.intro: FreeRice is a unique educational quiz game where answering questions correctly helps fund food donations. Created by the UN World Food Programme, it combines learning with charitable impact. Every right answer contributes to a good cause.
freerice.howToPlay: Choose a category — vocabulary, geography, math, and more. Answer questions correctly to earn grains of rice, which are funded by advertisers and donated to hunger relief. The more you answer correctly, the more rice you earn. It is a simple, feel-good way to learn and help.
freerice.modes: Single-player educational quizzes with charitable donations.
tips: Start with categories you know well.
Answer carefully — accuracy earns more.
Try new categories to broaden your knowledge.
Share with friends to multiply the impact.
freerice.controls: Mouse or keyboard — click answers or type responses.
features: Educational quizzes that fund food donations.
Multiple categories and difficulty levels.
Charitable impact with every answer.
Free to play in the browser.

faq.q: What is FreeRice?
faq.a: FreeRice is an educational quiz game where correct answers help fund food donations through the UN World Food Programme.

faq.q: How does the donation work?
faq.a: Advertisers pay for the rice, which is donated to hunger relief efforts.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, FreeRice is free to play.

freeciv.title: Freeciv
freeciv.intro: Freeciv is a free, open-source Civilization-style strategy game that runs in your browser. Build a civilization from ancient times to the space age, competing with other players or AI for dominance. With deep mechanics and endless replayability, it is a must-play for strategy fans.
freeciv.howToPlay: Start with a settler and found your first city. Explore the map, found more cities, and expand your territory. Research technologies, build improvements, and manage your economy. Diplomacy, warfare, and trade all play a role. Victory can be achieved through conquest, science, culture, or other conditions depending on the ruleset.
freeciv.modes: Single-player against AI and multiplayer with various rulesets and maps.
tips: Expand early — land is power.
Balance military, economy, and science.
Use diplomacy to avoid fighting on multiple fronts.
Learn the tech tree to plan your strategy.
freeciv.controls: Mouse and keyboard — click to select units and cities, use menus for commands.
features: Open-source Civilization-style strategy game.
Deep mechanics and many rulesets.
Single-player and multiplayer.

faq.q: Can I play in the browser?
faq.a: Yes, there is a browser version available.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, Freeciv is completely free and open source.

runescape.title: RuneScape
runescape.intro: RuneScape is one of the most iconic browser MMORPGs of all time. Explore a vast fantasy world, complete quests, level up dozens of skills, and interact with a massive community. It is a timeless adventure that has captivated millions of players for decades.
runescape.howToPlay: Create a character and enter the world of Gielinor. Complete quests, fight monsters, and train skills like combat, mining, fishing, and crafting. The game is open-ended — you can focus on whatever interests you. Join a clan, trade with other players, and explore the huge map. Progression is deep and rewarding.
runescape.modes: Persistent online MMORPG with quests, skills, and multiplayer interaction.
tips: Do quests early — they unlock useful rewards.
Train multiple skills to keep the game fresh.
Join a clan for social play and support.
Use the wiki for guidance on complex content.
runescape.controls: Mouse and keyboard — click to move, interact, and use abilities; keyboard for chat and shortcuts.
features: Classic browser MMORPG.
Dozens of skills and hundreds of quests.
Massive persistent world.
Free-to-play options available.

faq.q: What is RuneScape?
faq.a: RuneScape is a long-running browser MMORPG with quests, skills, and a huge fantasy world.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: There is a free-to-play version with optional membership for more content.

faq.q: Can I play in the browser?
faq.a: Yes, RuneScape has a browser client.

1v1-lol.title: 1v1.LOL
1v1-lol.intro: 1v1.LOL is a lightning-fast browser shooter that blends sharp gunplay with on-the-fly building, turning every duel into a test of reflexes and creativity. Whether you are throwing up walls to block incoming fire or editing your structure to gain the perfect angle, each match feels like a miniature chess game played at full speed. It is Fortnite-style combat distilled into pure, competitive 1v1 action.
1v1-lol.howToPlay: Enter a match and immediately begin gathering materials and preparing for combat. Shoot opponents with your weapon while building walls, ramps, and platforms to protect yourself and gain height. Switch between weapon and build modes instantly — the faster you build, the harder you are to hit. Win duels by eliminating your opponent before they eliminate you. Practice your build-fight combos; the best players chain shots and structures seamlessly.
1v1-lol.modes: 1v1 duels, plus practice and free-build modes to sharpen your mechanics.
tips: Always build a wall before peeking — never take an open fight.
Learn a few reliable ramp-rush patterns and drill them until they are muscle memory.
Use edits to create unexpected angles instead of firing through the same window.
Keep calm during build fights; panic building wastes materials and exposes you.
Aim training matters as much as building — a good shot ends fights faster than a fancy tower.
1v1-lol.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to aim, left click to shoot or place builds, right click to aim, Q to switch build mode, and number keys to select building pieces.
features: Fast-paced 1v1 shooter with building mechanics.
Instant browser play with no download.
Practice modes to improve building and aim.
Competitive duels that reward skill and creativity.
Smooth, responsive controls.

faq.q: What is 1v1.LOL?
faq.a: 1v1.LOL is a browser-based shooter with building mechanics where players fight one-on-one duels.

faq.q: Do I need to build to win?
faq.a: Building is a major advantage — it gives you cover and high ground, though good aim can still win fights.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, 1v1.LOL is free to play in your browser.

kirka-io.title: Kirka.io
kirka-io.intro: Kirka.io is a blocky browser FPS that captures the energy of classic voxel shooters while adding its own fast, competitive twist. With multiple game modes, smooth movement, and satisfying gunplay, it is easy to pick up but hard to put down. Whether you are sniping across a map or rushing in with a shotgun, every match is a fresh chance to prove your aim.
kirka-io.howToPlay: Choose a mode and spawn into a blocky battlefield. Pick your loadout from available weapons, then fight to complete your team's objective — capture zones, eliminate the enemy team, or hold positions. Movement is fast and vertical, so use the map's geometry to flank and surprise. Reload behind cover, communicate with teammates, and adjust your weapon choice to the range of each fight. The team that coordinates better usually wins.
kirka-io.modes: Multiple team-based modes including deathmatch, objective play, and more, with loadout customization.
tips: Keep your crosshair at head height while moving around corners.
Strafe while firing to make yourself a harder target.
Learn the map's flanking routes rather than always running down the middle.
Swap to a close-range weapon when entering tight indoor areas.
Reload immediately after every kill — fights often come in waves.
kirka-io.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to aim, left click to fire, right click to aim, R to reload, Space to jump, Shift to sprint, and number keys to switch weapons.
features: Blocky voxel FPS with smooth, competitive gunplay.
Multiple game modes to keep matches varied.
Loadout customization for different playstyles.
Fast matchmaking with no download.
Runs well on most browsers.

faq.q: What is Kirka.io?
faq.a: Kirka.io is a browser-based voxel FPS with multiple team modes and competitive shooting gameplay.

faq.q: Can I customize my weapons?
faq.a: Yes, you can choose loadouts between matches to fit your playstyle.

faq.q: Is Kirka.io free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play in your browser.

narrow-one.title: Narrow One
narrow-one.intro: Narrow One brings medieval combat to the browser with a bow, an arrow, and a whole lot of skill. Set in stylized castle arenas, it rewards precision, positioning, and patience over spray-and-pray aggression. Every shot is a commitment, and every hit is earned. If you enjoy tactical archery duels with a competitive edge, this is your game.
narrow-one.howToPlay: Join a team match and pick your role, then fight across castle-themed maps with a bow and arrows. Draw your bow to build power, aim carefully, and release to fire. Arrows arc with distance, so lead your targets and account for drop. Use cover, flank routes, and high ground to get clean shots. Work with teammates to push objectives and hold defensive positions. Reload and reposition between fights to avoid being caught out.
narrow-one.modes: Team-based archery combat with objective modes across multiple medieval maps.
tips: Aim slightly above distant targets to account for arrow drop.
Do not rush shots — a missed arrow is a free opening for the enemy.
Use walls and corners to peek-fire rather than standing in the open.
High ground gives you better sightlines and a harder target for enemies.
Coordinate pushes with teammates so enemies cannot pick you off one by one.
narrow-one.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to aim, hold left click to draw the bow and release to fire, right click to aim, Space to jump, and Shift to sprint.
features: Medieval archery FPS with team-based combat.
Castle-themed maps with verticality and cover.
Skill-based bow mechanics with arc and drop.
Multiple team modes and objectives.
Free to play in the browser.

faq.q: What is Narrow One?
faq.a: Narrow One is a browser-based medieval archery game where teams fight with bows and arrows across castle maps.

faq.q: Is aiming hard?
faq.a: It takes practice — arrows arc with distance and drop over range, so you need to lead your shots and aim high at long distances.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, Narrow One is free to play in your browser.

ev-io.title: ev.io
ev-io.intro: ev.io is a fast, futuristic arena FPS where mobility and abilities are just as important as aim. Sprint, jump, and slide across sci-fi maps while wielding a variety of weapons and skill-based abilities that redefine how fights play out. Whether you are teleporting behind an enemy or locking down a choke with area denial, the pace never stops and the skill ceiling never ends.
ev-io.howToPlay: Pick a loadout with a weapon and ability, then jump into a fast-paced arena match. Use your movement to dodge, flank, and control space. Your ability adds a tactical layer — use it to gain position, escape danger, or create an opening. Eliminate the enemy team while completing your match objective. Aim for headshots, chain your movement with your shots, and never stand still in the open.
ev-io.modes: Arena-style deathmatch and team objective modes with ability and loadout variety.
tips: Keep moving — standing still makes you an easy target for a skilled player.
Save your ability for a clutch moment rather than using it on cooldown.
Use vertical movement to escape when a fight goes bad.
Learn the map's jump routes and sliding lanes for faster rotations.
Aim for the head; body shots take much longer to secure a kill.
ev-io.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to aim, left click to fire, right click to aim, Space to jump, Shift to sprint or slide, and a key to activate your ability.
features: Fast-paced arena FPS with ability-based combat.
Multiple weapons and abilities for varied playstyles.
Sci-fi maps built for movement and verticality.
Competitive, skill-driven gameplay.
Playable instantly in the browser.

faq.q: What is ev.io?
faq.a: ev.io is a browser-based arena FPS featuring fast movement, unique abilities, and competitive matches.

faq.q: Do abilities matter?
faq.a: Yes — abilities add a tactical layer that can swing fights and should be used deliberately rather than spammed.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, ev.io is free to play in your browser.

repuls-io.title: Repuls.io
repuls-io.intro: Repuls.io is a sci-fi arena shooter that delivers frantic, close-quarters combat with a futuristic edge. Fast movement, punchy weapons, and tight arena layouts make every second feel like a firefight. If you love classic arena shooters but want something you can jump straight into from a browser tab, this delivers.
repuls-io.howToPlay: Spawn into an arena and start fighting. Pick up weapons scattered around the map or use your loadout, and use movement to dodge incoming fire while lining up your own shots. Control key areas of the map to force enemies into your crosshair. Eliminate opponents to score points and help your team win. Stay mobile — the arena is small and enemies can come from any direction.
repuls-io.modes: Arena shooter with team and free-for-all style matches.
tips: Never stop moving — a stationary target is a dead target.
Learn weapon spawn locations so you always have a strong option.
Control the high ground and chokepoints to dictate fights.
Use sound to anticipate enemies before they appear on screen.
Retreat and heal when low rather than trading blows you cannot win.
repuls-io.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to aim, left click to fire, right click to aim, Space to jump, and number keys to switch weapons.
features: Fast arena shooter with sci-fi visuals.
Multiple weapons and pickups to fight over.
Compact maps that force constant action.
Team and free-for-all matches.
Free browser play with no download.

faq.q: What is Repuls.io?
faq.a: Repuls.io is a browser-based sci-fi arena shooter with fast-paced multiplayer combat.

faq.q: Is it team-based?

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, Repuls.io is free to play in your browser.

gats-io.title: Gats.io
gats-io.intro: Gats.io is a snappy top-down shooter with a class system that gives every match a fresh tactical feel. Choose a loadout, pick your fights, and battle across a compact map where positioning and timing matter more than raw reflexes. With its minimalist visuals and deep class variety, it is a game that rewards smart play and quick thinking.
gats-io.howToPlay: Choose a class with its own weapon and stat profile, then spawn into the map and fight other players. Move around the arena using cover and terrain to control engagements. Each class has strengths and weaknesses — a sniper wins at range while a shotgun dominates close up. Collect powerups and use your mobility to outmaneuver opponents. Be the last player standing or help your team reach the objective depending on the mode.
gats-io.modes: Free-for-all and team-based top-down combat with multiple classes.
tips: Play to your class's range — do not fight close with a sniper or long with a shotgun.
Use walls and cover to break line of sight before re-engaging.
Switch classes between lives to counter what the enemy team is running.
Keep moving — top-down games punish players who stand still.
Learn when to disengage; retreating to reset a fight is often the best play.
gats-io.controls: Mouse and keyboard — WASD to move, mouse to aim, left click to shoot, and number keys to switch or select classes.
features: Top-down shooter with a class-based system.
Compact maps that encourage constant action.
Team and free-for-all modes.
Minimalist visuals for clear readability.
Free to play in the browser.

faq.q: What is Gats.io?
faq.a: Gats.io is a top-down multiplayer shooter with class-based combat and fast matches.

faq.q: Do different classes play differently?
faq.a: Yes — each class has its own weapon and stat profile, so playstyles vary widely.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, Gats.io is free to play in your browser.

wings-io.title: Wings.io
wings-io.intro: Wings.io puts you in the cockpit of a fast, agile fighter plane for multiplayer dogfights in the sky. Loop, dive, and outturn your opponents in a game that is all about aerial positioning and quick reflexes. With arcade flight controls and fast-paced combat, it turns the classic dogfight into something you can enjoy straight from your browser.
wings-io.howToPlay: Take to the skies and engage other players in aerial combat. Control your plane's pitch, roll, and throttle to outmaneuver opponents. Get behind enemy planes and fire your guns to bring them down. Use the environment and altitude to your advantage, and avoid getting caught in a turn fight you cannot win. Take down as many opponents as possible while staying alive yourself.
tips: Always try to get behind your target — head-on attacks are a coin flip.
Use altitude for energy; diving converts height into speed and options.
Break off a losing turn fight and reset rather than committing to it.
Keep an eye on your surroundings; third parties often show up mid-duel.
Learn to lead your shots — planes move quickly and bullets take time to travel.
wings-io.controls: Keyboard — arrow keys or WASD for pitch, roll, and throttle, with additional keys for firing weapons.
features: Multiplayer airplane dogfighting in the browser.
Arcade flight controls that are easy to learn.
Fast-paced aerial combat with plenty of action.
Free to play with no download.
Simple, readable visuals for clear dogfights.

faq.q: What is Wings.io?
faq.a: Wings.io is a browser-based multiplayer airplane dogfighting game where players fight for aerial supremacy.

faq.q: Is it hard to fly?
faq.a: The controls are arcade-style and easy to pick up, though advanced dogfighting takes practice.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, Wings.io is free to play in your browser.

brutal-io.title: Brutal.io
brutal-io.intro: Brutal.io is a physics-based arena fighter where momentum, timing, and a good sense of humor all play a role. Knock opponents off platforms, slam into them at speed, and use the environment itself as a weapon. Fast, chaotic, and endlessly replayable, it is a game that turns simple movement into deadly strategy.
brutal-io.howToPlay: Move your fighter around the arena using momentum and physics. Slam into opponents to knock them back and push them toward edges or hazards. Use platforms and terrain to build speed and set up angles. The last player or team standing wins, so avoid being near ledges when you are vulnerable. Timing your strikes is everything — a well-aimed slam can flip a fight in an instant.
brutal-io.modes: Multiplayer arena combat with physics-driven knockback and elimination gameplay.
tips: Build speed before you slam — momentum is your main weapon.
Fight in the center of the arena, not near edges, unless you are going for a kill.
Bait opponents toward ledges and dodge at the last second.
Watch your own position; accidental self-eliminations are common.
Use the arena's geometry to redirect your charge into a target.
brutal-io.controls: Mouse and keyboard — WASD or arrow keys to move, with the character following momentum and mouse direction for steering.
features: Physics-based arena combat with knockback mechanics.
Multiplayer matches with elimination gameplay.
Simple controls with deep timing skill.
Fast, chaotic fun with replay value.
Free to play in the browser.

faq.q: What is Brutal.io?
faq.a: Brutal.io is a physics-based multiplayer arena game where you knock opponents off platforms and use momentum to win.

faq.q: Is it competitive?
faq.a: Yes — despite its chaotic look, timing and positioning give skilled players a real edge.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, Brutal.io is free to play in your browser.

starblast-io.title: Starblast.io
starblast-io.intro: Starblast.io is a space shooter that mixes fast combat with mining, upgrades, and team strategy. Start in a fragile ship, mine asteroids for resources, and evolve your vessel into a powerful warship. Whether you are defending your team's base or diving into a heated dogfight, every decision about upgrades matters.
starblast-io.howToPlay: Spawn in space and mine asteroids to earn crystals, then spend them to upgrade your ship along different paths. Each upgrade tier unlocks new weapons and abilities. Fight enemy ships, defend your territory, and cooperate with your team to control the map. Balance mining and fighting — neglect one and your team suffers. The match ends when one team destroys the other's base or reaches the score goal.
starblast-io.modes: Team-based space combat with mining, ship progression, and base defense.
tips: Mine early to fund upgrades before the first big fight.
Pick upgrades that fit your role — a miner and a fighter should upgrade differently.
Stick near teammates; lone ships get picked off quickly.
Defend your base when it comes under attack; losing it can end the match.
Learn the upgrade tree so you do not waste crystals on the wrong path.
starblast-io.controls: Mouse and keyboard — WASD or arrow keys to fly, mouse to aim, left click to fire, and number keys for upgrades and abilities.
features: Space shooter with mining, combat, and team strategy.
Ship upgrade paths that change how you play.
Team-based matches with base defense.
Multiplayer combat in the browser.
Deep progression within each match.

faq.q: What is Starblast.io?
faq.a: Starblast.io is a browser-based space game where players mine asteroids, upgrade ships, and fight in team battles.

faq.q: How do I upgrade my ship?
faq.a: You mine crystals and spend them on upgrade paths that unlock better weapons and abilities.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, Starblast.io is free to play in your browser.

rocketbot-royale.title: RocketBot Royale
rocketbot-royale.intro: RocketBot Royale is a vehicle battle royale where rocket-powered bots tear across the map in a battle for survival. Drive, drift, and blast your way through a shrinking arena while fighting both players and environmental hazards. If you like your battle royale with a heavy dose of vehicular chaos, this is the one.
rocketbot-royale.howToPlay: Drop into the map with your rocket-powered vehicle and gather weapons and upgrades scattered around the arena. The safe zone shrinks over time, forcing everyone together. Drive and drift to dodge fire while lining up your own shots. Eliminate opponents and be the last vehicle standing. Mobility is life — a stationary bot is a dead bot.
rocketbot-royale.modes: Vehicle-based battle royale with a shrinking play zone.
tips: Keep moving — drifting and circling makes you much harder to hit.
Use cover to break line of sight and repair or reposition.
Grab upgrades early; they compound over the course of a match.
Do not get boxed in near the zone edge — leave room to escape.
Save a strong weapon for the final circle instead of wasting it early.
rocketbot-royale.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to drive, mouse to aim, left click to fire, Space for handbrake or boost, and Shift for additional speed control.
features: Vehicle-based battle royale with rocket-powered bots.
A shrinking play zone that forces fast action.
Weapons and upgrades scattered across the map.
Fast, chaotic matches with plenty of strategy.
Free browser play.

faq.q: What is RocketBot Royale?
faq.a: RocketBot Royale is a browser-based battle royale where you control a rocket-powered vehicle and fight to be the last one standing.

faq.q: Can I upgrade my vehicle?
faq.a: Yes — you pick up weapons and upgrades around the map to improve your chances.

faq.q: Is it free?
