Complete mission objectives — such as reaching a distance, overtaking a number of vehicles, or finishing a route without crashing — to earn cash. Spend that cash on new bikes or upgrades to improve speed, handling, and braking. Crashes end your run or cost you time, so reading traffic flow and choosing the right gaps is everything. The faster you ride, the more you earn, but the less room you have for error.
traffic-rider.modes: Single-player career-style missions and endless run gameplay, with first-person and third-person motorcycle control.
tips: Look far ahead down the road, not at the car directly in front of you.
Weave smoothly — sudden swerves at high speed are how runs end.
Near misses earn extra rewards, so skim close when it is safe.
Upgrade handling and brakes before raw top speed early on.
Save up for a better bike rather than repeatedly repairing a weak starter model.
traffic-rider.controls: Keyboard, mouse, or touch — arrow keys or WASD to steer and accelerate, with touch controls offering tilt or on-screen buttons on mobile.
features: First-person and third-person motorcycle racing with realistic traffic.
Over 30 bikes to unlock and upgrade.
Mission-based progression alongside endless high-score runs.
Beautiful 3D highways and city scenery.
Plays instantly in the browser on desktop and mobile.

faq.q: What is Traffic Rider?
faq.a: Traffic Rider is a first-person motorcycle racing game where you dodge traffic, complete missions, and upgrade a garage of bikes.

faq.q: How do I earn money in Traffic Rider?
faq.a: You earn cash by completing missions, hitting speed and distance goals, and pulling off near misses with traffic.

faq.q: Can I play Traffic Rider on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, the game supports touch controls and works on mobile browsers as well as desktop.

minecraft-real.title: Minecraft Real
minecraft-real.intro: Minecraft Real brings the blocky, endless creativity of Minecraft to your browser through a full voxel sandbox. Mine resources, craft tools, build sprawling structures, and survive the night against hostile mobs in a world that is entirely yours to shape. Whether you want to construct a fortress, explore caves for rare ores, or simply wander a procedurally generated landscape, the only limit is your imagination.
minecraft-real.howToPlay: You spawn into a randomly generated block world with nothing but your hands. Punch trees to gather wood, craft basic tools, and work your way up to better equipment by mining stone, iron, and diamonds. Build shelter before nightfall, because monsters spawn in the dark. Explore caves, hunt for resources, and expand your base as you grow stronger. The game supports both creative building and survival play, so you can decide how much danger you want in your world.
minecraft-real.modes: Survival mode with crafting, mining, and hostile mobs, plus creative-style building and free exploration.
tips: Build a shelter and light it before your first night — darkness means monsters.
Always carry a stack of blocks so you can pillar up or wall yourself off quickly.
Never dig straight down; you can fall into lava or a deep cavern.
Craft a set of stone tools before hunting for iron to save time.
Keep food on hand — hunger drains fast while mining and fighting.
minecraft-real.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to look, left click to break blocks, right click to place blocks or use items, Space to jump, Shift to sneak, E to open inventory, and number keys to select hotbar slots.
features: A full voxel sandbox with mining, crafting, and building.
Procedurally generated worlds with caves, ores, and biomes.
Survival gameplay with hunger, health, and hostile mobs.
Runs in the browser with no installation needed.
Playable solo or in a shared world depending on the server.

faq.q: What is Minecraft Real?
faq.a: Minecraft Real is a browser-playable voxel sandbox (based on Eaglercraft) where you can mine, craft, build, and survive in a blocky world.

faq.q: Do I need the official Minecraft launcher?
faq.a: No. It runs directly in your browser, so you can play without installing the official game.

faq.q: Can I play in creative mode?
faq.a: Yes, depending on the world or server you join, creative-style building and free exploration are available.

fallzone-io.title: FallZone.io
fallzone-io.intro: FallZone.io drops you onto a shrinking battlefield where building is your greatest weapon and survival is the only goal. As the safe zone tightens, you must gather resources, throw up defenses, and outgun everyone standing between you and victory. Fast, chaotic, and endlessly replayable, it blends battle royale tension with the creative freedom of a building sandbox.
fallzone-io.howToPlay: You parachute into a map with other players and race to collect weapons, materials, and supplies. Build walls, ramps, and structures to protect yourself and gain high ground. The playable area shrinks over time, forcing players together and guaranteeing firefights. Eliminate opponents while staying inside the zone, and be the last player standing to win. Every match is different, so adapting your building and fighting style on the fly is the key skill.
fallzone-io.modes: Free-for-all battle royale with solo survival and building-focused combat.
tips: Gather building materials early — they are your armor in the late game.
Build upward for height advantage when an enemy has the drop on you.
Stay near the edge of the safe zone rather than the center to avoid ambushes.
Do not over-build; a simple ramp or wall is often faster and safer than a tower.
Land in a quieter area, loot up, then rotate in as the zone shrinks.
fallzone-io.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to aim, left click to shoot or place blocks, right click to build, Space to jump, and number keys to switch items.
features: Battle royale gameplay with a shrinking play zone.
A full building system that lets you construct cover and towers.
Free to play directly in the browser.
Fast match pacing that keeps downtime to a minimum.
Multiple weapons and items to find and use.

faq.q: What is FallZone.io?
faq.a: FallZone.io is a free browser-based battle royale game where you fight other players and build structures to survive as the zone shrinks.

faq.q: Is building required to win?
faq.a: Building is strongly recommended — it gives you cover, high ground, and protection during fights, but skilled aim can still carry you.

faq.q: Is FallZone.io free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play in your browser on desktop.

truck-simulator.title: Truck Simulator 1
truck-simulator.intro: Truck Simulator 1 puts you behind the wheel of a heavy haulage rig and hands you the keys to the highway. Deliver cargo across city streets and open roads, manage your speed through tight turns, and keep your load intact from pickup to drop-off. It is a relaxed but focused driving experience where patience, smooth control, and a good sense of your vehicle's size are what separate a clean delivery from a wrecked trailer.
truck-simulator.howToPlay: Accept a delivery contract, then drive your truck along the assigned route to the destination. Steer carefully through traffic, obey the road where required, and avoid collisions that damage your cargo. The heavier your load, the slower you accelerate and the longer you need to brake, so plan corners and stops in advance. Complete deliveries to earn money and progress to bigger jobs, better trucks, and longer routes.
truck-simulator.modes: Single-player delivery campaign with free driving on city and highway routes.
tips: Brake early — a loaded trailer takes far longer to stop than a car.
Take corners wide; cutting them risks clipping traffic or the curb.
Watch your mirrors when changing lanes, especially with a long trailer.
Smooth, gentle steering prevents jackknifing and keeps cargo safe.
Do not chase speed — a clean delivery always beats a fast crash.
truck-simulator.controls: Keyboard or touch — arrow keys or WASD to accelerate, brake, and steer, with on-screen controls available on mobile devices.
features: Realistic heavy truck driving with cargo delivery objectives.
City and highway routes with traffic to navigate.
Progression through increasingly demanding jobs.
Runs smoothly in the browser via HTML5.
Playable on desktop and mobile.

faq.q: What is Truck Simulator 1?
faq.a: It is a browser-based truck driving simulation where you haul cargo along city and highway routes and try to deliver it without damage.

faq.q: Is it difficult to control the truck?
faq.a: It is easy to learn but takes practice — the truck is heavy and slow to stop, so smooth steering and early braking matter.

faq.q: Does it need a download?
faq.a: No, it runs directly in your browser as an HTML5 game.

truck-simulator-yandex-515138.title: Truck Simulator 2
truck-simulator-yandex-515138.intro: Truck Simulator 2 expands the haulage experience with more routes, heavier loads, and a deeper sense of what it takes to run a trucking operation. Navigate busy roads, manage your speed and braking over long distances, and deliver every cargo safely to its destination. It is a calm, methodical driving game built for players who enjoy the rhythm of the road and the satisfaction of a perfect delivery.
truck-simulator-yandex-515138.howToPlay: Select a job and take control of your truck, then follow the route to your delivery point. Traffic, tight turns, and long braking distances demand steady hands. Damage your cargo or your rig and the payout suffers, so drive with care rather than aggression. Successful deliveries earn money that unlocks better trucks and more challenging contracts, letting you build a proper trucking career one route at a time.
truck-simulator-yandex-515138.modes: Single-player delivery gameplay with progressive contracts and free driving between jobs.
tips: Maintain a safe following distance — you cannot stop on a dime with a full load.
Use the full width of the road on wide turns to avoid clipping the trailer.
Reduce speed before entering junctions rather than braking mid-turn.
Check your route before you set off so you are not making last-second turns.
Prioritize a damage-free delivery over a fast one for better rewards.
truck-simulator-yandex-515138.controls: Keyboard, mouse, or touch — arrow keys or WASD for steering, throttle, and braking, with touch buttons available on mobile.
features: Browser-based truck driving simulation with cargo hauling.
Multiple routes with traffic and road hazards.
Progression system that rewards careful, damage-free driving.
HTML5 powered, so it loads instantly with no install.
Works on desktop and mobile devices.

faq.q: What is Truck Simulator 2?
faq.a: It is a browser truck driving simulation where you haul cargo along routes and aim to deliver it safely while managing your speed and steering.

faq.q: How is it different from the first Truck Simulator?
faq.a: It offers a different set of routes and contracts with the same core haulage gameplay, giving you more driving variety.

faq.q: Is it free to play?
faq.a: Yes, it is free and runs directly in your browser.

igi-2.title: IGI 2: Covert Strike
igi-2.intro: IGI 2: Covert Strike is a classic tactical first-person shooter that rewards patience, planning, and precision over reckless firefights. As a covert operative, you infiltrate hostile facilities, gather intelligence, and eliminate targets while staying one step ahead of enemy patrols. Every level is a puzzle of sightlines and alarm states, and every mistake can escalate a quiet infiltration into a full-blown firefight.
igi-2.howToPlay: You are deployed into a mission area with specific objectives — gather intel, sabotage equipment, rescue a target, or eliminate a key figure. Study patrol routes, use silenced weapons to take down guards quietly, and avoid triggering alarms that summon reinforcements. Use cover, crouch to steady your aim, and conserve ammunition. Complete objectives and reach the extraction point to finish the mission. Loud, aggressive play is possible but far riskier than a careful, methodical approach.
igi-2.modes: Single-player tactical campaign with objective-based missions.
tips: Observe patrol patterns before moving — timing beats brute force.
Use a silenced weapon for guards and save loud guns for emergencies.
Crouch to improve accuracy at range and stay below sightlines.
Check objectives constantly; wandering aimlessly gets you spotted.
Retreat and reposition instead of standing your ground when outnumbered.
igi-2.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to aim, left click to fire, right click to aim down sights, C to crouch, R to reload, and E to interact with objects.
features: Classic tactical FPS gameplay with stealth-focused missions.
Objective-based levels that reward planning over aggression.
Authentic weapons and equipment to manage.
Runs in-browser through the BottleShip player.
A nostalgic throwback to old-school tactical shooters.

faq.q: What is IGI 2: Covert Strike?
faq.a: It is a classic tactical first-person shooter in which you play a covert operative completing stealth and objective-based missions.

faq.q: Can I play it in the browser?
faq.a: Yes, it runs in your browser through the BottleShip player, so no separate installation is needed.

faq.q: Is stealth required?
faq.a: Stealth is strongly encouraged — going loud usually triggers alarms and enemy reinforcements that make missions much harder.

gta-san-andreas.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
gta-san-andreas.intro: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas is one of the most ambitious open-world games ever made, and now it runs right in your browser. Spanning three sprawling cities and the countryside between them, it follows a man returning home to find his family in trouble and his neighborhood under threat. With deep customization, a huge map, and a story full of unforgettable characters, it remains the gold standard for sandbox crime games.
gta-san-andreas.howToPlay: Complete story missions to advance the narrative, or roam freely across the entire state. Drive cars, ride bikes, fly planes, and sail boats as you move between Los Santos, San Fierro, and Las Vegas-inspired Las Venturas. Fight with fists, melee weapons, and firearms, and manage your character's stats, appearance, and territory. Side activities include racing, gambling, property management, and gang warfare. How you spend your time is entirely up to you.
gta-san-andreas.modes: Single-player open-world campaign with extensive free-roam, side missions, and minigames.
tips: Eat and exercise regularly — your character's fitness affects speed and stamina in fights.
Complete side missions early to unlock better weapons and vehicles.
Learn the map's highways for fast travel between cities.
Keep a fast vehicle at your safehouse for escape missions.
Save after every major milestone so a failed mission never costs you progress.
gta-san-andreas.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to aim, left click to attack, right click to aim, E or F to enter vehicles, Space to jump or handbrake, and number keys to switch weapons.
features: Three massive cities and huge stretches of countryside to explore.
A long story campaign with side missions and minigames.
Character customization including fitness, appearance, and skills.
Driving, flying, boating, shooting, and gang warfare in one game.
Playable in the browser via the BottleShip player.

faq.q: What is Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas?
faq.a: It is a legendary open-world crime game set across three cities and surrounding countryside, featuring a long story campaign and total freedom to roam.

faq.q: Can I play San Andreas in a browser?
faq.a: Yes, this version runs in your browser through the BottleShip player without a traditional installation.

faq.q: Is free roam available?
faq.a: Absolutely — you can ignore the story entirely and explore, drive, and cause chaos across the whole map.

mafia-1.title: Mafia
mafia-1.intro: Mafia is a cinematic crime epic set in the 1930s, where fast cars, sharper suits, and dangerous loyalties define every day. You are pulled into a world of bootlegging, extortion, and betrayal, and must survive long enough to earn your place among men who do not forgive mistakes. With atmospheric city streets, weighty driving physics, and a story-driven campaign, it is a classic mob drama you can play.
mafia-1.howToPlay: Follow the story mission by mission, completing jobs that range from chauffeuring and deliveries to robberies and shootouts. Drive period-accurate cars through the city — and be aware that they handle heavily and break down if abused. In combat, use cover, aim carefully, and manage your ammunition. Between missions you can explore the city, but the campaign is the heart of the experience. Complete each chapter to see the story unfold.
mafia-1.modes: Single-player story campaign set in an open city with mission-based progression.
tips: Drive carefully — police notice reckless driving and cars take damage fast.
Use cover in every firefight; standing in the open is a death sentence.
Conserve ammunition by aiming deliberately rather than spraying.
Learn the city layout so you can escape police pursuits quickly.
Save between missions; failing mid-mission can cost you a long drive.
mafia-1.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move or drive, mouse to aim, left click to fire, right click to aim, E to enter vehicles, and R to reload.
features: A story-driven campaign set in a richly detailed 1930s city.
Period-accurate vehicles with weighty driving physics.
Cover-based gunfights and tactical combat.
Runs in-browser through the BottleShip player.
An atmospheric crime drama with memorable characters.

faq.q: What is Mafia?
faq.a: Mafia is a classic story-driven crime game set in the 1930s, following a man drawn into the underworld of organized crime.

faq.q: Do I need to install it?
faq.a: No. It runs directly in your browser via the BottleShip player.

faq.q: Is the driving realistic?
faq.a: The cars have deliberately heavy, period-appropriate handling, so you need to brake early and drive with care.

venge-io.title: Venge.io
venge-io.intro: Venge.io is a sharp, competitive browser FPS built for players who love tactical team play. Fast movement, tight gunplay, and distinct character abilities combine into matches that reward coordination and quick decision-making. Every round is a chance to outthink your opponents, control key positions, and land the shots that swing the fight.
venge-io.howToPlay: Join a team match and pick a character with unique abilities. Work with your teammates to control the map, secure objectives, and eliminate the enemy team. Use your abilities to gain an edge — whether that is mobility, area denial, or direct damage — and combine them with your weapon fire. Reload behind cover, communicate your pushes, and adapt to how the enemy team is playing. Winning comes from controlling space as a group rather than hunting for solo kills.
venge-io.modes: Team-based competitive matches with objective and elimination-style play, featuring multiple characters with unique abilities.
tips: Move with your team — solo pushes rarely survive against grouped defenders.
Save your character ability for the moment it swings a fight, not for random use.
Hold angles and let enemies walk into your crosshair rather than chasing kills.
Reload before you push, not after you are already committed.
Watch which lanes the enemy favors and shift your team to counter them.
venge-io.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to aim, left click to fire, right click to aim or use ability, Shift to sprint, Space to jump, and a key for your character's special ability.
features: Competitive tactical FPS gameplay in the browser.
Multiple characters with distinct abilities.
Team-based modes that reward coordination.
Smooth, responsive gunplay and movement.
No installation — play instantly.

faq.q: What is Venge.io?
faq.a: Venge.io is a browser-based tactical first-person shooter with team modes and character abilities that emphasize competitive play.

faq.q: Do characters have special abilities?
faq.a: Yes, each character has a unique ability you can use alongside your weapons to gain a tactical advantage.

faq.q: Is Venge.io free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play directly in your browser.

warbrokers-io.title: War Brokers
warbrokers-io.intro: War Brokers is a browser FPS that goes bigger than most, adding tanks, jeeps, and combined-arms warfare to the mix. Infantry firefights, vehicle duels, and coordinated pushes across open maps create battles that feel large and unpredictable. If you want a shooter where a well-driven tank can turn the tide, this is the one.
warbrokers-io.howToPlay: Join a match and choose how you want to fight — on foot with a rifle, behind the wheel of a jeep, or commanding a tank. Infantry capture objectives, hold positions, and support vehicles; vehicles break fortified positions and dominate open ground. Work as a squad, coordinate your pushes, and use the terrain for cover. The team that controls the battlefield and the objectives wins, so balance your forces between infantry and armor.
warbrokers-io.modes: Multiplayer team battles with combined infantry and vehicle combat across multiple maps.
tips: Do not fight tanks in the open as infantry — flank them or use cover.
Keep a repair option handy if you are driving; vehicles under fire break down.
Use vehicles to break stalemates but support them with infantry.
Communicate before pushing an objective so your team moves together.
Learn the map's vehicle spawns to control the armor early.
warbrokers-io.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to aim, left click to fire, right click to aim, R to reload, E to enter and exit vehicles, and Space to jump.
features: Combined infantry and vehicle warfare in the browser.
Tanks, jeeps, and other vehicles to pilot.
Multiple maps with objective-based team combat.
Large-scale battles with plenty of strategic depth.
Runs instantly with no download.

faq.q: What is War Brokers?
faq.a: War Brokers is a browser-based multiplayer FPS that combines infantry combat with drivable tanks, jeeps, and other vehicles.

faq.q: Can I drive vehicles in the game?
faq.a: Yes — you can pilot tanks, jeeps, and other vehicles, and they play a major role in winning matches.

faq.q: Is War Brokers free to play?
faq.a: Yes, it is free and runs directly in your browser.

voxiom-io.title: Voxiom
voxiom-io.intro: Voxiom is a voxel battle royale where building and shooting are equally important. The world is made of blocks, and so are your defenses — mine materials, construct cover, and turn the terrain into a weapon as the safe zone closes in. With fast fights and total freedom to reshape the battlefield, no two matches play out the same way.
voxiom-io.howToPlay: Land on the map and gather weapons, resources, and building blocks. Mine the environment to collect materials, then place blocks to build walls, ramps, and towers for protection and high ground. The storm shrinks the playable area, forcing players together. Eliminate opponents and stay alive until you are the last one standing. Because building is instant, fights often become rapid constructions and counter-constructions, so flexibility matters as much as aim.
voxiom-io.modes: Voxel battle royale with solo and squad-style play, focused on building and shooting.
tips: Mine resources whenever you have downtime — materials win late-game fights.
Build a quick wall the instant you take fire to break your opponent's aim.
Use ramps to gain height, then shoot down at enemies below.
Do not build a huge base in the open — it paints a target on you.
Rotate toward the zone early so you are not caught in the storm.
voxiom-io.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to aim, left click to shoot or break blocks, right click to place blocks, Space to jump, and number keys to switch items.
features: Voxel battle royale with destructible and buildable terrain.
Full building system for instant cover and high ground.
Multiple weapons and resources to collect.
Free to play in the browser.
Fast, replayable matches with shifting battlefields.

faq.q: What is Voxiom?
faq.a: Voxiom is a browser-based voxel battle royale where you mine resources, build structures, and fight other players until only one is left.

faq.q: Is building important in Voxiom?
faq.a: Yes — building is central to the game, letting you create cover, gain height, and block enemy shots in real time.

faq.q: Is Voxiom free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play directly in your browser.

surviv-io.title: Surviv.io
surviv-io.intro: Surviv.io is the original top-down battle royale that proved a browser game could deliver real tension. Drop onto a huge map, loot weapons and armor, and fight to be the last person standing while the deadly red zone closes in. Simple to read and brutally competitive, it is a game of positioning, resource management, and nerves.
surviv-io.howToPlay: You start with nothing and must scavenge weapons, ammunition, healing items, and armor from buildings and crates scattered across the map. The safe zone shrinks over time, and standing in the red area drains your health fast. Fight other players, use cover, and manage your inventory carefully. Play solo, or team up in duos and squads where reviving teammates becomes part of the strategy. Survive to the final circle and win.
surviv-io.modes: Solo, duo, and squad battle royale with shrinking safe zones.
tips: Always keep healing items in your inventory — they decide close fights.
Rotate early so you are never forced to run through the red zone.
Use trees, rocks, and buildings as cover; open ground is death.
Squad up so a downed teammate can be revived instead of eliminated.
Swap to a shotgun in close-quarters buildings and a rifle in the open.
surviv-io.controls: Mouse and keyboard — WASD or mouse to move, left click to shoot, right click to interact or use items, R to reload, and number keys to switch weapons. Movement can be aim-based.
features: Top-down battle royale with solo, duo, and squad modes.
A large map full of lootable buildings and cover.
A shrinking red zone that forces constant movement.
Deep inventory and healing management.
Instant browser play with no download.

faq.q: What is Surviv.io?
faq.a: Surviv.io is a top-down browser battle royale where you loot weapons and supplies, avoid the shrinking zone, and fight to be the last player or team alive.

faq.q: Can I play with friends?
faq.a: Yes, the game supports duo and squad modes so you can team up with other players.

faq.q: Is Surviv.io free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play in your browser.

zombsroyale-io.title: Zombs Royale
zombsroyale-io.intro: Zombs Royale takes the battle royale formula and makes it fast, colorful, and instantly playable in your browser. Drop in, loot up, and fight in a top-down world where matches move quickly and the action never stops. With a huge variety of weapons and many game modes, it is one of the most accessible and replayable royales on the web.
zombsroyale-io.howToPlay: Choose a mode and drop onto the map. Search buildings and crates for weapons, ammo, shields, and healing items. The safe zone steadily shrinks, pushing all remaining players together. Fight with your squad or alone, using cover and terrain to gain an edge. Manage your shields and health, swap weapons to suit the range of each fight, and be the last one standing. Different modes change the rules and pace, so there is always a fresh way to play.
zombsroyale-io.modes: Multiple battle royale modes including solo and squad play, with varied rulesets and match sizes.
tips: Top up shields whenever you find them — they act as a second health bar.
Carry one close-range and one long-range weapon to cover all situations.
Stay near the edge of the safe zone to avoid being surrounded.
In squads, share loot and revive teammates instead of looting alone.
Do not chase kills into the storm — the zone kills faster than you think.
zombsroyale-io.controls: Keyboard and mouse, or touch — WASD to move, mouse to aim and shoot, R to reload, and keys to switch weapons. Mobile play uses dual on-screen joysticks.
features: Fast-paced 2D battle royale with many game modes.
A large arsenal of weapons and consumables.
Solo and squad play with reviving.
Playable in the browser on desktop and mobile.
Quick matchmaking with no download required.

faq.q: What is Zombs Royale?
faq.a: Zombs Royale is a fast, browser-based battle royale with top-down 2D action, lootable weapons, and multiple game modes.

faq.q: Does it have squads?
faq.a: Yes, you can play solo or team up in squad modes, including reviving fallen teammates.

faq.q: Is Zombs Royale free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play in your browser.

deadshot-io.title: Deadshot.io
deadshot-io.intro: Deadshot.io is a competitive browser FPS built for quick, intense matches where aim and movement decide everything. There is no fluff here — you spawn, you fight, and you win or lose on your reflexes. Tight hitboxes, fast pacing, and clean visuals make it a favorite for players who want a pure shooter experience without waiting through long lobbies.
deadshot-io.howToPlay: Jump into a match and immediately start fighting. Use your weapon and movement to outplay opponents, taking advantage of cover and angles. Matches are short, so every kill and every death matters. Aim for the head, control your recoil, and reposition constantly — standing still makes you an easy target. Learn the maps' sightlines and use them to control fights. The first player or team to reach the match objective wins.
deadshot-io.modes: Fast-paced competitive multiplayer FPS with short match formats.
tips: Keep your crosshair at head height as you move around corners.
Strafe while shooting to make yourself harder to hit.
Use short bursts at range to control recoil and stay accurate.
Learn the map's main lanes and pick angles that favor your weapon.
Reload immediately after every fight — you never know when the next one starts.
deadshot-io.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to look and aim, left click to fire, right click to aim down sights, R to reload, Space to jump, and Shift to sprint.
features: Competitive browser FPS with short, fast matches.
Responsive movement and precise gunplay.
Multiple maps and weapons to master.
No download — play instantly.
Designed for players who love pure aim-based competition.

faq.q: What is Deadshot.io?
faq.a: Deadshot.io is a competitive browser-based first-person shooter focused on fast matches and precise gunplay.

faq.q: Do I need to download it?
faq.a: No, it runs directly in your browser.

faq.q: Is Deadshot.io good for competitive players?
faq.a: Yes, its short matches and aim-focused gameplay make it well suited to competitive shooter fans.

bonk-io.title: Bonk.io
bonk-io.intro: Bonk.io is pure, chaotic physics fun. You control a ball-like fighter and bash opponents off the arena in a game that is easy to learn and hilarious to master. With custom maps, private rooms, and a community full of creative game modes, it is the kind of game you play for a laugh and end up staying for hours.
bonk-io.howToPlay: Move your character around the arena and use momentum to knock other players into the void. Your weight and speed affect how hard you hit and how hard you get hit. Use walls and platforms to reposition, build up speed, and time your strikes. Push enemies off the edge while avoiding the same fate yourself. Custom maps and modes change the rules, so each room can offer something entirely different.
bonk-io.modes: Multiplayer physics fighting with public matches, private rooms, and custom maps and game modes.
tips: Build momentum before you strike — speed equals knockback power.
Use walls to bounce off and reposition without losing control.
Aim your hits toward the nearest edge of the arena.
Stay near the center when you are heavier; force light opponents to the rim.
Learn the map before fighting hard — edges and gaps are everywhere.
bonk-io.controls: Keyboard — arrow keys or WASD to move, with additional keys for actions depending on the mode. Mouse may be used for aiming in some custom modes.
features: Physics-based multiplayer fighting with knockback gameplay.
Private rooms so you can play with friends.
Custom maps and community-created modes.
Easy to learn but full of skill expression.
Runs directly in the browser.

faq.q: What is Bonk.io?
faq.a: Bonk.io is a multiplayer physics fighting game where you knock opponents off the arena using momentum and timing.

faq.q: Can I play with friends?
faq.a: Yes, you can create or join private rooms and play with people you know.

faq.q: Are there custom maps?
faq.a: Yes, the community creates custom maps and modes, so the game constantly offers new ways to play.

taming-io.title: Taming.io
taming-io.intro: Taming.io blends survival, combat, and creature collection into one continuous multiplayer world. You start by gathering resources and building a base, then tame wild animals that fight alongside you, gather for you, and grow stronger as you do. With other players competing and cooperating around you, every session is a race to build, defend, and thrive.
taming-io.howToPlay: Gather wood, stone, and food to survive, then build structures to protect yourself and your resources. Tame animals by meeting their requirements, and they will follow you, fight for you, and help you gather. Level up your character and your pets to unlock better gear and stronger abilities. Other players can attack your base or your pets, so you need defenses and allies. Expand, upgrade, and stake out your territory in a persistent world.
taming-io.modes: Multiplayer survival and combat with taming, base building, and progression.
tips: Tame a combat pet early so you can fight and gather with backup.
Build walls around your key resources before you start upgrading.
Keep food in reserve — starving mid-fight is a quick way to lose everything.
Level your pets by using them; stronger pets make every fight easier.
Ally with other players when possible; solo survival gets rough later on.
taming-io.controls: Mouse and keyboard — WASD to move, mouse to aim and interact, left click to attack or gather, and number keys to switch tools or items.
features: Survival gameplay with base building and resource gathering.
A taming system with many animals that fight and gather for you.
Multiplayer world with other players to fight or ally with.
Character and pet progression with upgrades.
Free to play in the browser.

faq.q: What is Taming.io?
faq.a: Taming.io is a browser-based multiplayer survival game where you gather resources, build a base, and tame animals that help you fight and work.

faq.q: Do pets help you fight?
faq.a: Yes — tamed animals follow you, attack enemies, and can be leveled up to become stronger over time.

faq.q: Is Taming.io free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play in your browser.

wormate-io.title: Wormate.io
wormate-io.intro: Wormate.io takes the classic snake formula and turns it into a colorful, competitive multiplayer feast. Grow your worm by eating candy and sweets, cut off opponents to make them drop their food, and fight your way up the leaderboard. Simple to control, hard to master, and endlessly addictive in short bursts.
wormate-io.howToPlay: Guide your worm around the map eating candy and food to grow longer. The longer you get, the higher you climb on the leaderboard — but also the easier you are to trap. Use speed boosts to close in on prey or escape danger, but boosting drains your length. Cut off other worms so they crash into you and drop their food, then scoop it up. Avoid head-on collisions and keep moving to survive.
wormate-io.modes: Multiplayer free-for-all arcade mode with a live leaderboard.
tips: Only boost when you are sure of the payoff — it costs you length.
Circle smaller worms to trap them against your body.
Stay near the map edges less often; you need room to escape.
Eat dense candy clusters to grow fast instead of chasing single pieces.
Do not get greedy near bigger worms — one wrong turn ends your run.
wormate-io.controls: Mouse or touch — your worm follows the cursor or your finger. Click or press to boost. On mobile, use touch-drag to steer.
features: Multiplayer snake-style arcade gameplay.
A live leaderboard that makes every run competitive.
Colorful candy-themed maps and skins.
Playable on desktop and mobile browsers.
Quick sessions that are easy to pick up and put down.

faq.q: What is Wormate.io?
faq.a: Wormate.io is a multiplayer arcade game in the snake style, where you eat sweets to grow, trap other worms, and climb the leaderboard.

faq.q: How do I grow faster?
faq.a: Eat candy and food consistently, and cut off other worms so they drop their food for you to collect.

faq.q: Is Wormate.io free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play in your browser.

hole-io.title: Hole.io
hole-io.intro: Hole.io is a delightfully chaotic arcade game where you play as a hungry hole in the ground. Start small, swallow everything you can fit, and grow large enough to consume entire buildings. With other holes competing for the same city, it becomes a race to eat the most and dominate the map before time runs out.
hole-io.howToPlay: Move your hole around the city and swallow objects smaller than you. Start with benches, cones, and trash cans, then work your way up to cars, trees, and eventually whole buildings as you grow. Other players control their own holes and will compete for the same objects — and can even swallow you if you are much smaller. Grow as fast as possible before the timer ends, and finish with the highest score.
hole-io.modes: Multiplayer arcade free-for-all with timed matches and a score leaderboard.
tips: Prioritize dense clusters of small objects early to grow quickly.
Avoid bigger holes until you have grown enough to compete.
Move to areas with large buildings once you can swallow them.
Do not linger in crowded spots where other holes are eating everything.
Keep moving constantly — standing still wastes growth time.
hole-io.controls: Mouse, keyboard, or touch — move your hole with the mouse or arrow keys, or drag your finger on mobile.
features: Arcade gameplay where you swallow a whole city.
Real-time competition against other player-controlled holes.
Timed matches with a score leaderboard.
Playable on desktop and mobile browsers.
Satisfying growth progression from tiny to gigantic.

faq.q: What is Hole.io?
faq.a: Hole.io is a multiplayer arcade game where you control a hole in the ground and swallow objects to grow bigger while competing against other holes.

faq.q: Can other players eat me?
faq.a: Yes — a much larger hole can swallow you, so it pays to avoid bigger opponents until you have grown.

faq.q: Is Hole.io free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play in your browser.

paper-io.title: Paper.io
paper-io.intro: Paper.io is a colorful territory game where every move you make claims land. Expand your paper-colored zone by drawing loops around empty space, but be careful — your trail is vulnerable, and rivals are always looking to cut you off. Simple, fast, and surprisingly strategic, it turns a simple concept into a tense multiplayer contest.
paper-io.howToPlay: You control a small character that leaves a trail behind it. Move out into unclaimed territory and return to your own zone to seal off the loop, claiming everything inside as your territory. Expand your percentage of the map as quickly as possible. If another player touches your trail while you are outside your territory, you are eliminated. Cut off rivals by circling them, and avoid being caught out of position yourself.
paper-io.modes: Multiplayer free-for-all territory control with a live map percentage leaderboard.
tips: Make small, safe loops early instead of one huge risky one.
Watch for players approaching your trail and retreat immediately.
Cut off enemies by circling the area they are claiming.
Stay near your own territory so you can close loops fast.
Do not get greedy near the leaderboard leaders — they know how to defend.
paper-io.controls: Mouse, keyboard, or touch — steer your character with the mouse or arrow keys, or drag on mobile.
features: Territory-claiming gameplay with simple loop mechanics.
Multiplayer competition with a live percentage leaderboard.
Bright, colorful visuals.
Playable on desktop and mobile browsers.
Quick matches that are easy to learn.

faq.q: What is Paper.io?
faq.a: Paper.io is a multiplayer territory game where you claim land by drawing loops, competing with other players to cover the most of the map.

faq.q: How do I lose in Paper.io?
faq.a: If another player touches your trail while you are outside your own territory, you are eliminated.

faq.q: Is Paper.io free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play in your browser.

tetr-io.title: TETR.IO
tetr-io.intro: TETR.IO is a modern, competitive take on the falling-block puzzle genre, built for players who want precision, speed, and a real ranking system. With buttery-smooth controls, a clean interface, and deep mechanical skill ceilings, it is the definitive way to play Tetris-style games in your browser. Casual players can enjoy endless stacking, while competitive players can climb the ladder.
tetr-io.howToPlay: Blocks fall from the top of the screen and you rotate and position them to form complete lines, which then clear. Clearing multiple lines at once and chaining clears builds score and sends garbage to opponents in versus modes. Learn the hold and next-piece previews, use hard drops to move quickly, and manage your stack height. In ranked play, you face other players in real time, sending attacks and surviving their garbage. The goal is simple: survive, clear lines, and outlast your opponent.
tetr-io.modes: Solo play, ranked multiplayer versus, and custom lobbies with adjustable rules.
tips: Keep your stack flat — uneven stacks limit your options fast.
Use the hold feature to save a piece you cannot place well.
Practice hard drops and rotations until they are muscle memory.
In versus, build up a large attack and send it all at once.
Learn to play from both previews so you are never surprised by the next piece.
tetr-io.controls: Keyboard — left and right arrow keys to move, up or X to rotate clockwise, Z or Ctrl to rotate counter-clockwise, down to soft drop, Space to hard drop, and C or Shift to hold.
features: Competitive Tetris-style puzzle gameplay in the browser.
Ranked multiplayer matchmaking.
Smooth, highly responsive controls with modern mechanics.
Solo and custom lobby modes.
A clean interface and active competitive community.

faq.q: What is TETR.IO?
faq.a: TETR.IO is a competitive browser-based falling-block puzzle game in the Tetris style, featuring ranked multiplayer and modern mechanics.

faq.q: Does it have ranked play?
faq.a: Yes, TETR.IO includes ranked multiplayer matchmaking so you can climb the competitive ladder.

faq.q: Can I play solo?
faq.a: Yes, solo play and custom lobbies are available alongside ranked multiplayer.

generals-io.title: Generals.io
generals-io.intro: Generals.io is a tight, fast-moving strategy game about territory, supply lines, and outmaneuvering your opponent. Every tile matters, every move reveals information, and the simplest-looking decisions can decide the whole match. It is easy to learn in a minute and deep enough to keep you thinking for hours.
generals-io.howToPlay: You begin with a general tile and some land. Each turn, your tiles generate armies based on their value. Move armies between adjacent tiles to expand into neutral territory or attack your opponent. Capture enemy land, cut off their supply routes, and eventually take their general to win. Fog of war hides much of the map, so scouting and guessing your opponent's plans is a core part of the game. Moves happen simultaneously each turn, so prediction matters.
generals-io.modes: Multiplayer matches including 1v1 and free-for-all, with ranked and casual play options.
tips: Do not overextend — thin armies get cut off and destroyed easily.
Control high-value tiles early; they generate the most armies.
Watch for gaps in your opponent's territory that reveal their general.
Keep some armies in reserve to defend against sudden attacks.
In free-for-all, let others fight first and expand when they are weakened.
generals-io.controls: Mouse and keyboard — click a tile to select it, then click an adjacent tile to move armies. Keyboard shortcuts are available for faster play.
features: Fast, tactical multiplayer territory strategy.
Simultaneous turns so every match is a mind game.
Fog of war that makes scouting and prediction essential.
Multiple modes including 1v1 and free-for-all.
Runs in the browser with no download.

faq.q: What is Generals.io?
faq.a: Generals.io is a fast multiplayer strategy game where you expand territory, move armies, and try to capture the enemy general.

faq.q: How long do matches last?
faq.a: Matches are short and fast-paced, often finishing in just a few minutes.

faq.q: Is Generals.io free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play in your browser.

minecraft-classic.title: Minecraft Classic
minecraft-classic.intro: Minecraft Classic is the official free, browser-based version of the game that started a worldwide phenomenon. With no survival pressure and no monsters, it is pure creative sandbox building — just you, an infinite block world, and the freedom to construct anything you can imagine. It is also a great way to build and explore with up to ten friends at once.
minecraft-classic.howToPlay: You spawn into a block world with an unlimited supply of blocks. Choose a block type from the hotbar, then place and break blocks to build whatever you want. There is no hunger, no health, and no danger — the focus is entirely on creativity. Explore the generated terrain, carve out caves, build structures, or work together with other players in the same world. Everything you create exists only for that session unless it is shared.
minecraft-classic.modes: Creative sandbox play with support for multiplayer worlds of up to 10 players.
tips: Plan large builds roughly before you start so you do not waste time.
Use contrasting blocks to outline shapes before filling them in.
Build from the ground up and check your proportions from a distance.
In multiplayer, divide big builds between players to finish faster.
Experiment with block combinations — texture mixing makes builds look better.
minecraft-classic.controls: Keyboard and mouse — WASD to move, mouse to look, left click to break blocks, right click to place blocks, Space to jump, Shift to sneak, and number keys to select blocks.
features: Official free browser version of Minecraft Classic.
Unlimited blocks and full creative building.
Multiplayer worlds for up to 10 players.
No monsters, hunger, or survival pressure.
Runs instantly with no installation.

faq.q: What is Minecraft Classic?
faq.a: It is the official free browser version of Minecraft focused purely on creative building, with unlimited blocks and no survival mechanics.

faq.q: Can I play with friends?
faq.a: Yes, Minecraft Classic supports multiplayer worlds for up to 10 players.

faq.q: Is Minecraft Classic free?
faq.a: Yes, it is completely free and runs directly in your browser.

geo-fs.title: GeoFS
geo-fs.intro: GeoFS is a remarkably detailed flight simulator that runs entirely in your browser, letting you take to the skies over real-world scenery. Choose from a range of aircraft, from light prop planes to commercial jets, and fly anywhere on the globe. With realistic flight dynamics and satellite-based terrain, it is an accessible but genuine taste of aviation.
geo-fs.howToPlay: Select an aircraft and an airport, then take off using the throttle and controls. Manage your speed, pitch, and heading to climb, cruise, and descend safely. The instruments give you altitude, speed, and navigation information, and the world below is mapped from real satellite imagery. Practice landings carefully — approach too fast or too steep and you will crash. Longer flights let you navigate between airports and explore different regions.
geo-fs.modes: Free flight simulation with multiple aircraft and global scenery, plus multiplayer where available.
tips: Climb gradually at a steady speed rather than pulling back hard.
Reduce throttle and descend gently on approach to avoid overshooting the runway.
Watch your airspeed indicator — stalling is the most common beginner mistake.
Trim your aircraft so you are not constantly fighting the controls.
Practice takeoffs and landings at a single airport before flying long routes.
geo-fs.controls: Keyboard and mouse — arrow keys or W/S for pitch and throttle, A/D for roll, and additional keys for rudder and flaps. Mouse control can also be used for steering.
features: Free browser-based flight simulator with global satellite scenery.
A range of aircraft from light planes to airliners.
Realistic flight dynamics and instrument readouts.
Multiplayer flying in supported sessions.
No installation — fly directly from your browser.

faq.q: What is GeoFS?
faq.a: GeoFS is a free browser flight simulator that lets you fly various aircraft over real-world satellite-mapped scenery.

faq.q: Is GeoFS realistic?
faq.a: It offers accessible but genuine flight dynamics, including stall behavior and instrument-based navigation, though it is easier than a full desktop simulator.

faq.q: Can I fly anywhere in the world?
faq.a: Yes, the entire globe is available to explore, and you can take off from and land at many airports.

cookie-clicker.title: Cookie Clicker
cookie-clicker.intro: Cookie Clicker is the legendary idle game that turned a single click into an obsession. You start by baking one cookie at a time, then build a sprawling empire of grandmas, farms, factories, and stranger things, all working to produce cookies while you are away. It is deceptively simple, wonderfully absurd, and dangerously hard to stop playing.
cookie-clicker.howToPlay: Click the big cookie to earn cookies. Spend those cookies on buildings and upgrades that produce cookies automatically over time. The more you invest, the faster your production grows. Unlock achievements, buy powerful upgrades, and watch your cookies-per-second climb into absurd numbers. The game continues generating cookies even while you are offline, so returning after a break means a huge payout. Prestige mechanics let you reset for permanent bonuses once you reach a certain point.
cookie-clicker.modes: Single-player idle progression with an offline production system and prestige resets.
tips: Buy the cheapest efficient upgrades early to snowball your production.
Prioritize buildings with the best cookies-per-second-per-cost ratio.
Check back regularly for golden cookies, which give strong temporary boosts.
Do not ignore achievements — many grant permanent bonuses.
Prestige once progress slows down; the permanent multiplier is worth the reset.
cookie-clicker.controls: Mouse — click the big cookie to bake, and click buildings and upgrades to purchase them.
features: The classic idle clicker that defined the genre.
Hundreds of upgrades, buildings, and achievements.
Offline cookie production while you are away.
Prestige system for long-term progression.
Plays instantly in the browser.

faq.q: What is Cookie Clicker?
faq.a: Cookie Clicker is a famous idle game where you bake cookies by clicking, then build automated production to generate cookies continuously.

faq.q: Does it keep running when I close it?
faq.a: Yes, the game continues producing cookies while you are offline, and you collect the earnings when you return.

faq.q: Is Cookie Clicker free?
faq.a: Yes, the browser version is free to play.

kittens-game.title: Kittens Game
kittens-game.intro: Kittens Game is a deep, text-based civilization builder that hides remarkable complexity beneath a simple interface. Starting with a single kitten gathering catnip, you gradually develop a society through science, industry, and trade, expanding from a humble village into a sprawling civilization. It is a slow-burn idle game for players who love resource chains, long-term planning, and the satisfaction of watching numbers grow.
kittens-game.howToPlay: Assign your kittens to jobs like farming, woodcutting, mining, and science, and build structures that unlock new resources and improvements. Research technologies to advance your civilization, manage happiness and storage limits, and balance production chains. Progress is persistent and continues while you are away, so the game rewards planning rather than constant clicking. Over time you unlock seasons, trade, religion, and eventually resets that let you start over with permanent bonuses.
kittens-game.modes: Single-player idle civilization building with persistent offline progression and long-term resets.
tips: Keep happiness high — it boosts almost all production.
Balance your jobs; too many kittens on one resource starves the others.
Prioritize storage upgrades before big production pushes.
Unlock new technologies as soon as you can afford them; they compound.
Be patient — Kittens Game is a marathon, not a sprint.
kittens-game.controls: Mouse and keyboard — click buttons and tabs to assign jobs, build structures, and research technology.
features: Deep civilization-building idle game with complex resource chains.
Technology research, trade, religion, and seasonal mechanics.
Persistent progression that continues offline.
Long-term reset and prestige systems.
Runs entirely in the browser.

faq.q: What is Kittens Game?
faq.a: Kittens Game is a text-based idle civilization builder where you grow a kitten society through resource management, technology, and expansion.

faq.q: Is Kittens Game complicated?
faq.a: It starts simple but grows deeply complex, with many interacting systems and resource chains to manage.

faq.q: Does it progress while I am offline?
faq.a: Yes, the game continues running and generating resources while you are away.

little-alchemy-2.title: Little Alchemy 2
little-alchemy-2.intro: Little Alchemy 2 is a charming puzzle sandbox where the entire world is built from combinations. Start with four basic elements and combine them to discover everything from fire and water to life, myth, and beyond. With hundreds of items to find and a relaxing, curiosity-driven pace, it is the kind of game that quietly eats an afternoon.
little-alchemy-2.howToPlay: Drag elements from your sidebar onto the workspace and drop one on top of another to combine them. If the combination is valid, a new element appears and is added to your collection. Start with simple pairs like water and fire to make steam, then work outward into more complex discoveries. The goal is to find every element, and the game offers hints and categories to help when you get stuck. There is no timer or failure — just experimentation.
little-alchemy-2.modes: Single-player puzzle sandbox with free experimentation and a full element collection to complete.
tips: Keep commonly used base elements like water and air easily accessible.
Write down or remember combinations you have already tried.
Think logically — most results follow real-world relationships.
Use hints when you are stuck rather than giving up on a branch.
Explore categories like life, myth, and technology for hidden chains.
little-alchemy-2.controls: Mouse or touch — drag and drop elements to combine them, and click items in your list to place them.
features: Hundreds of elements to discover through combination.
Relaxing, no-pressure puzzle gameplay.
Hint system to help when you get stuck.
Playable on desktop and mobile.
Charming visuals and sound design.

faq.q: What is Little Alchemy 2?
faq.a: It is a puzzle sandbox game where you combine basic elements to discover hundreds of new ones, from simple objects to mythical creatures.

faq.q: How many elements are there?
faq.a: There are hundreds of elements to discover across many categories, and the game is designed to be explored over many sessions.

faq.q: Is there a time limit?
faq.a: No — there is no timer or failure state, so you can experiment at your own pace.

a-dark-room.title: A Dark Room
a-dark-room.intro: A Dark Room begins with a single line of text and grows into one of the most surprising games you will ever play. What starts as a minimalist survival experience quietly expands into a deep simulation with crafting, exploration, and a genuinely compelling story. It is a game best experienced without knowing too much — just start the fire and see where it takes you.
a-dark-room.howToPlay: You begin tending a fire in a dark room, gathering wood and building up a settlement. As you add structures and people, the game opens up into crafting, resource management, and eventually exploration into the wider world. Assign workers to gather resources, manage your supplies carefully, and unlock new systems as you progress. Later sections introduce travel, combat, and a mysterious narrative. Everything is driven by text and menus, so the experience is all in the decisions you make.
a-dark-room.modes: Single-player narrative survival and simulation with multiple stages of progression.
tips: Keep your fire burning — it is the foundation of your early survival.
Do not rush the early game; build a stable supply before expanding.
Assign workers carefully; overcommitting to one resource causes shortages.
Prepare well before you leave the settlement for the first time.
Go in without spoilers — the discovery is the best part of the game.
a-dark-room.controls: Mouse and keyboard — click buttons and choose options from menus to gather, build, and explore.
features: A minimalist text-based survival game with a surprising depth.
Crafting, settlement management, and exploration systems.
A unique narrative that unfolds through play.
Runs in any browser with no download.
Deep progression that rewards patience.

faq.q: What is A Dark Room?
faq.a: A Dark Room is a minimalist text-based survival and simulation game that starts simply and grows into a deep, story-driven experience.

faq.q: Is it difficult?
faq.a: It is more about careful resource management than reflexes, and the challenge grows gradually as new systems unlock.

faq.q: Is it free to play?
faq.a: Yes, the browser version is free.

territorial-io.title: Territorial.io
territorial-io.intro: Territorial.io is a strategy game about maps, momentum, and the art of the well-timed attack. Start with a single piece of land and expand across a stylized map, balancing aggression against the need to defend what you have claimed. It is easy to jump into and surprisingly deep, with matches that swing wildly on a single bold decision.
territorial-io.howToPlay: You begin with a small territory and a population that grows over time. Select your land and attack adjacent tiles to expand, spending population to launch attacks. Larger territories generate more troops but are harder to defend. Choose whether to attack neutral land, weaker players, or gang up on the leader. Alliances can form and break, and the map's geography shapes who can attack whom. Control the most territory when the match ends to win.
territorial-io.modes: Multiplayer territory strategy with free-for-all matches and varying map types.
tips: Expand into neutral land early to build a population advantage.
Do not leave your borders thin — a counterattack can collapse you quickly.
Time your attacks for when an opponent is already fighting someone else.
In free-for-all, avoid becoming the biggest threat too early.
Consolidate captured territory before pushing further.
territorial-io.controls: Mouse and keyboard — click to select territory, then click adjacent tiles to attack. Keyboard shortcuts speed up troop allocation.
features: Fast multiplayer territory strategy gameplay.
Multiple maps and match sizes.
Simple rules with deep strategic decisions.
Playable in the browser with no download.
Quick matches that reward bold play.

faq.q: What is Territorial.io?
faq.a: Territorial.io is a browser-based multiplayer strategy game where you expand territory, manage population, and compete to control the most land.

faq.q: How do I win?
faq.a: You win by controlling the most territory when the match ends, which means balancing expansion with defense.

faq.q: Is Territorial.io free?
faq.a: Yes, it is free to play in your browser.

86555.title: Escape School Duel Arcade Adventure Challenge Game Play...
86555.intro: Escape School Duel Arcade Adventure Challenge Game Play... is a racing game built around one clear objective you repeat across short levels. You learn the patterns, time your moves carefully, and try to go a little farther each attempt. It suits players who enjoy quick sessions with steady, satisfying progress and no complicated setup.
86555.howToPlay: In Escape School Duel Arcade Adventure Challenge Game Play..., you begin by learning the basic goal and moving through the first stage. You repeat the same core loop across levels, improving as you memorize the patterns. A clock or limited move count adds pressure to each attempt. A friend can join in, turning the same stages into a side-by-side contest. Each level is a little harder than the one before, and a run ends when you miss the objective or reach the finish. Steady timing, careful positioning, and patience matter more than raw speed alone.
86555.modes: The game offers solo, 2 player. Each mode uses the same core rules, so practice in one carries over to the others, and you can switch between them whenever you want a different pace.
tips: In two-player mode, coordinate with your partner instead of rushing ahead alone.
Focus on one objective at a time to keep each run under control.
Replay an earlier stage if a newer one feels too difficult.
Small, steady progress beats one risky move every time.
Keep each attempt short and focused on a single goal.
86555.controls: Mouse or touch — click, drag, or tap to play.
features: Local multiplayer so a friend can join on the same device.
Simple controls that are easy to pick up.
Increasing difficulty as you progress.
Bright visuals and clear feedback on every action.

faq.q: What is Escape School Duel?
faq.a: Escape School Duel is a browser-based arcade game built around a single clear objective that you repeat across levels, improving as you go.

faq.q: How do you play Escape School Duel?

faq.q: Is Escape School Duel free to play?
faq.a: Yes — it runs in your browser and is free to play on desktop and mobile.
